top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a defined, mature physiological discovery whose clinical consequences in diabetes and obesity are exceptionally broad and durable. Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker provide the most defensible discovery-centered allocation when the citation is confined to GLP-1 physiology that enabled therapy, rather than the distributed subsequent development of medicines.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict is apparent from the supplied profile. The profile notes approximately twenty co-authored works with fellow committee member Thomas Perlmann, a count not independently audited; he is not a proposed laureate in this configuration.
